💾 Backup & Restore Your Progress

Everything you build here — your name, target score, test history, bookmarks, wrong-question queue, streaks and goals — is saved only in this browser, on this device. It is not stored on any server, so switching devices, clearing browser data, or reinstalling will lose it unless you back it up first.

How to move to a new device/browser: tap "Export Backup" here to download a small .json file containing all your saved data. Carry that file to your new device (via email, WhatsApp, Drive, etc.), open NEXT WHITE there, come back to this My Account page, and tap "Import Backup" to restore everything exactly as it was.

💡 Tip: export a fresh backup every week or two, and always right before switching phones/laptops or clearing your browser's storage.
